response.overview: Wawan is a poetic short documentary set in the heart of Jakarta. Through fragments of everyday life, the film observes Wawan with patience and intimacy, allowing gestures, silence, and surrounding sounds to tell the story. As the city moves relentlessly around him, moments of solitude and human connection emerge, revealing a portrait of quiet resilience. Blending observational imagery with an immersive soundscape, the film becomes a reflection on dignity, memory, and the unseen lives that exist within the noise of a modern metropolis
response.tagline: A quiet life beneath the noise of Jakarta.
response.title: WAWAN
